result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d change how easily people can fail to see other people as fully real.

Not to make everyone agree. Not to erase conflict. Just to make other minds, other lives, other fears harder to reduce to a category, a threat, or an abstraction. A lot of the world’s harm comes from that narrowing. If that narrowing were less automatic, violence would lose much of its permission.
